newsitem.title: USA: Woman accused of starving girl has twins.
newsitem.headline: Woman accused of starving girl has twins.

text.p: A jailed New York City woman accused of starving her daughter to death has given birth to twin girls, authorities said Wednesday.
Carla Lockwood faces murder charges in the 1996 death of her 4-year-old daughter Nadine. Prosecutors allege Lockwood starved the girl because she said she did not love her.
A neighbour told local newspaper reporters that Lockwood hid the starving child from child welfare workers by borrowing the neighbour's child and claiming she was Nadine.
The twins, born Feb. 25, were to be placed in foster care as early as Wednesday, authorities said. Lockwood gave birth at a local hospital and has since been returned to jail.
Lockwood, 32, has six other children, aged 1 to 14. They all have been in foster care since their mother's arrest in September. Police said they appeared to be in good condition at the time.
